text:
Unfortunately, opened soil can't be returned unless it's faulty, even though you're within the 30-day return window (8 days since delivery). If you ordered this soil and it just turns out to be unsuitable for your cactus, it isn't eligible for a return.

If we sent a different soil from what you ordered, that's a wrong-item case, and we'd ship the correct one free by Express (where your zone allows) with a free return label. Can you check whether the bag matches your order? If it doesn't, I can escalate it to a Support Lead, since the policy doesn't say how opened wrong items are handled.

For future soil choices, a Plant Care Specialist can give free advice by chat or email on what suits your cactus.
